name: P2P Stream
description: Stream torrents straight into Jellyfin. Built-in torrent sources (no extra software), TMDB catalogs as libraries, search for any movie or show from the Jellyfin search bar, and Burst-style quality filters.

versions.changelog: Security and reliability release. New: stream links follow the address each device used, so playing away from home through a reverse proxy works without a setting; each person's Version choice is their own; an option to hide the search libraries from the home screen while keeping them in search. Security: playback and the Version menu respect library access; stream links shown to apps no longer include the stream token; new stream tokens are made on the server, optionally stopping old links at once; links from search results and torrents can't reach your home network; .torrent downloads are size-limited; searches set to use the proxy never go direct. Reliability: faster first play (searches don't wait for a site that isn't answering, which is then skipped for a few minutes; faster peer connections); each torrent downloads into its own folder; catalogs sharing a folder no longer remove each other's titles; catalog collections only change collections the plugin made; season packs play the right episode file; rewriting links after a new token takes about a minute instead of up to an hour; fixes for subtitle files, Trakt sign-in, the torrent limit, cache sizes, log messages and setting descriptions.

Pre-loads the next episode, playback safety fixes for season packs and subtitle files, subtitles for torrents you add, Trakt without a Client Secret, and removing unused catalog folders. See the release notes.
First stable release: on-demand torrent streaming with built-in sources, catalogs, Version menu, fast starts, release subtitles, VPN privacy and port forwarding. See the release notes.
The log says, once per release, how many subtitle files it had (or why none were added).
Subtitle files that come with a release (.srt, .ass, .ssa, .vtt) are offered in Jellyfin's subtitle menu, labelled by language (Playback > Faster start, on by default).
